√śū 'swell'
present: śváyati etc. 
perfect: śuśāva śiśvāya śūśuvus etc. śūśuvat śūśuve śū́śuvāna 
aorist: [1.] śūyāt -- [2.] áśvat -- [3.] aśiśviyat aśūśuvat aśiśvayat -- [5.] aśvayīt 
[future: śvayiṣyati śvayitā ]
verbal: śváyitum śūṣáṇi 
secondary: śūyate śośu- śeśvi- śiśvayiṣa- śvāyaya- 
derivatives: -śū? śáva B.+ śāva E.+ -śvan V.+ śávas V.+ śavasāná RV. śáviṣṭha V.B. śotha C. śuná V.B.S. śū́na V.+ śū́nyá V.+ śū́ra V.+ śávīra RV. śivá V.+ śéva V.+ -śévas AV. -śvāyin B. śvayana C. śvayátha B. śvayathu C. śvātrá V.B. śvāntá RV. śíśu V.+ -śíśvan RV. -śiśvi RV. 
The perfect forms in RV. are ascribed by BR. (perhaps with better reason) to a separate root śū 'prevail'. The connection of a part of the derivatives given here with one another and with any assignable root is open to much question.

√sū 'generate, enliven, impel'
present: [2.] sū́te súvate etc. V.+ suvāná svāná? sauti B.+ suhi sūhi -- [6.] suváti etc. sva suvate etc. -- [4.] sūyate etc. B1.+ sūyati etc. E.+ -- [1.] savati etc. E.+

aorist: [1.] asāvi -- [3.] asūṣavat asuṣot asuṣavus -- [4.] asauṣīt soṣṭa U.+ -- [5.] asāvīt etc. sāviṣat asaviṣṭa

secondary: passive: sūyáte etc. V.+ -- intensive: soṣavīti -- desiderative: susūṣa- -- causative: sāvaya- 
derivatives: sū́ V.+ savá V.+ sávya? (n.) RV. -savin C. sávana V.+ -súvana AV. -savas B.S. sū́ti V.+ -suti RV. sū́tu AV. savitṛ́ V.+ -savītṛ RV. sūtrī́ AV. strī́? V.+ savatha? C. -sūna S.+ sūnú V.+ -sū́ma V. -sū́ya AV.+ sū́ra? V. sūrí? V.+ sávīman V.B.S. -sū́van V. sūṣā́ AV. sūṣaṇā? AV. 
Usually divided into two roots, 1su/sū 'impel', and 2su/sū 'give birth' (the verb-forms of the former, with three or four sporadic exceptions, limited to the older language); but their forms and meanings are mixed beyond the possibility of successful separation.
